memory._comment: Indexes ~/memory/*.md with Voyage AI embeddings (markdown-aware chunking). Run 'npx voyageai-cli pipeline ~/memory/*.md --db memory --collection notes --create-index' to initialize. Tools: search_vectors, embed_text, retrieve_documents.

memory-local._comment: Fallback: local-only LanceDB embeddings (no API key needed). Enable this and disable 'memory' above if you don't want Voyage AI.

github._comment: GitHub API access — alternative to gh CLI
